title: The Mean-Field Limit of Online Stochastic Vector Balancing
summary: We study an online vector balancing problem, in which $n$ independent Gaussian random vectors $\boldsymbolζ(1),\dots,\boldsymbolζ(n) \sim \mathcal{N}(0, I_n)$, each of dimension $n$, arrive one at a time. The goal is to choose signs $\varepsilon(1),\dots,\varepsilon(n) \in \{\pm 1\}$ with $\varepsilon(k)$ depending only on $\boldsymbolζ(1),\dots,\boldsymbolζ(k)$, so as to minimize the expected $\ell^{\infty}$ norm of the signed sum $\frac{1}{\sqrt{n}}\sum_{k = 1}^n \varepsilon(k) \boldsymbolζ(k)$.
